implementation.targetScope: VentiMath non-compiler Vite alias resolution: inherited exact/wildcard paths, base URL, importer filtering, eager/lazy local discovery and explicit configuration invalidation. File logging and compiler-backed mode are excluded.

changes: Independent resolver over vtsconfck with native path.matchesGlob instead of globrex and no debug runtime dependency.
Exact aliases and longest wildcard prefixes preserve precedence; target fallbacks preserve queries and Vite resolution options.
No module-result cache retains missing or deleted targets; JSON config changes invalidate parsed discovery state and watchers detach on shutdown.

caller.scope: Actual vite.config.mts uses vite-tsconfig-paths5.1.4 with parseNative:false. Current stable6.1.1 and app5.1.4 controls; v7 is a prerelease, not the stable target.
